messages:
mira: FYI summarizing the hybrid GPTQ/AWQ sweep across Llama/Mistral/Qwen we ran today
sam: appreciate it, TL;DR?
mira: TL;DR: gptq8 still best latency/cost for Llama-2-70B (EM delta vs FP16 ~ -0.7%), Mistral-7B variants show ~ -0.4% on ROUGE/generation, Qwen-14B exhibits codebench regressions with vanilla gptq8 (~ -1.9% on code-sim; hallucination +2.3% in long-context)
alex: narrow that down more? per-layer or KV-specific?
mira: looks KV/chunked-attn sensitive: lower layers quantized with GPTQ and upper layers with AWQ (hybrid split at layer 30/total) reduced code delta to -0.3% while keeping latency within +6% on our C+ kernels
jonp: consistent across seeds/tasks?
mira: reproducible across 3 seeds for 1k code samples and holds on 2k long-context runs. ppl/lm benchmarks unchanged
tara: what about memory and KV cache impact?
mira: hybrid-kv config increased KV mem ~1.1x vs gptq-only, still ~1.7x less than FP16 on 70B. AWQ-only was ~1.02x memory vs gptq and had slightly higher per-token cost
sam: deployment recommendation?
mira: decision table pasted below

```
- hosted (free/lowest tier): default -> gptq8 (per-tensor); fallback -> awq for routes failing eval gating
- hosted (pro): default -> gptq8; route-level overrides allowed for code/long-context routes -> awq-hybrid if needed
- dedicated: default -> awq-hybrid for Qwen-14B code routes; gptq8 otherwise. allow per-tenant override
- private/on-prem: recommend per-customer sweep; provide both gptq8 and awq-hybrid configs
```

mira: rollout guardrails: canary 1% traffic + 24h deterministic eval at 48h, auto-rollback if relative accuracy loss >0.7% or hallucination +2% absolute
sam: where are artifacts?
mira: s3://redwood-evals/hybrid-gptq-sweep/1971023456/{model}/{profile}/report.json
alex: reproduce locally command?
mira: 
```
./eval_harness.sh --model qwen-14b --profile hybrid-layer30 --tasks code-sim,long-context --seeds 42,99,123 --out ./out/qwen-hybrid.json
```
ci-bot: infra-checks passed
ci-bot: eval-artifact uploaded -> https://s3.redwood/hybrid-gptq-sweep/1971023456-summary.csv
jonp: I'll prototype an automated layer-split heuristic (loss-driven) and try it on 8k context Qwen tomorrow
tara: I'll add product note recommending defaults per plan and a short blurb for customer-facing docs
sam: thanks all, please drop any unexpected regressions in #incidents and tag @mira
mira: opening RFC for hybrid-kv quant next week. assigning follow-ups: jonp (hybrid heuristic), alex (long-context perf), tara (docs/product), sam (release calendar)
